description: This file contains the implementation of the authentication service for a backend system, including user registration, login, JWT token creation/validation, and password policy enforcement. It defines classes, functions, and constants related to authentication logic.

classes.name: AuthServiceError
classes.description: Base class for authentication service related exceptions.

classes.name: InvalidCredentialsError
classes.description: Raised when user credentials are invalid.

classes.name: TokenValidationError
classes.description: Raised when JWT token validation fails.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Main class encapsulating user registration, authentication, token creation, and validation logic.

methods.name: bool _password_within_bcrypt_bounds(password: str)
methods.description: Checks whether a given password's UTF-8 byte length is between 8 and 72 bytes, inclusive.

methods.name: User register_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Registers a new user after enforcing password length policies.

methods.name: Tuple[User,str] authenticate_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user and generates a JWT token upon success.

methods.name: str _create_access_token(self, *, subject: str)
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with a subject claim and expiration.

methods.name: TokenPayload decode_token(self, token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, returning the token payload or raising an error.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user_by_id(self, db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a User record from the database by user ID.

ctags.name: authenticate_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def authenticate_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)

ctags.name: get_user_by_id
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_user_by_id(self, db: Session, user_id: int) -> Optional[User]:$/

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def register_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str) -> User:$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
